Title: Public Preview – Data Migration for Oracle

Body.Content:
The Data Migration for Oracle extension is a powerful tool that enables you to migrate your Oracle databases to the Azure platform with ease. It provides a seamless migration experience from the source Oracle database to the target platform using Azure Database Migration Service. This includes Oracle to SQL migrations.

The extension offers both offline and online data migration for critical databases, ensuring minimal downtime for the migration process. This is particularly important for businesses that rely heavily on their databases, as any disruption to database access can result in significant losses.  

Learn more.
